E2116

`jet {command}` doesn't handle `.{extension}` files like `{file}`.

What

`jet {command}` doesn't handle `.{extension}` files like `{file}`.

Why

Jet tells a file's language by its extension, and `jet {command}` takes {accepted}.

Fix

Give `jet {command}` a `.jet` file; `jet run` and `jet build` also compile C (`.c`) and C++ (`.cc`, `.cpp`, `.cxx`).
